scenes.animationPrompt: A full-length vertical 9:16 Studio Ghibli style 2D anime key visual. A serene Sufi dervish gracefully whirling in a state of spiritual bliss atop a high mountain meadow. The dervish wears a traditional tall brown sikke cap and wide, fluidly billowing white robes that expand organically with the rotation. Wind rustles through lush green grass and vibrant wildflowers. In the background, majestic misty mountain peaks and ancient wind-swept cedar trees frame the scene. Magical golden hour lighting, illuminated by piercing volumetric sunbeams that cast a warm glow and rim light over the spinning fabric. Visible breeze swirls with floating golden leaves and light motes. Hand-painted anime aesthetic, high detail, watercolor textures, cinematic composition, breathtaking atmosphere.
